title: Non-Conformance Report
description: Governance artifact emitted by coordinator.py when the annotate->prove->reconcile loop cannot converge (exit 72/73). Conforms to cmmi-glue Workflow 3 (SQA Audit & Non-Compliance Escalation); the Workflow-3 escalation chain is bound in config/skills/cmmi-glue/SKILL.md (coordinator exit 72/73 -> agent-meta-monitor -> agent-feature-supervisor -> human).

date_issued.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp the NCR was issued.

issued_by.description: The SQA-Auditor role that detected the non-conformance (here: coordinator).

responsible_role.description: Engineering role bound to remediate, derived from the reconcile target (Specifier=agent-writer/agent-splitter; sub-actor=agent-script-update).

checkpoint.description: What was being audited, e.g. 'PyCSL annotate->prove->reconcile loop for <file>'.

finding.description: The non-conformance: what process expectation was violated.

exit_code.description: Coordinator exit code (72 = max retries, 73 = loop/ping-pong).

retry_count.description: Number of attempts made before halting.

consecutive_identical.description: How many times the same recommendation recurred (exit 73), or null (exit 72).

recurring_recommendation.description: The recommendation text that could not be resolved.

target.description: The reconcile target the recommendation routed to.

fault_class.description: The reconcile fault classification, if present.

log_paths.description: Paths to the reconcile/update logs that are the audit trail.

response_timeframe.description: When a Corrective Action Plan is due (Workflow-3 default: 5 business days).

escalation_path.description: The cmmi-glue Workflow-3 escalation chain this NCR feeds.

cap_placeholder.description: Empty Corrective Action Plan slot for the responsible role to fill.
